script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for July 31. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.

Every living thing is related.  Trace your ancestry far enough back and you share grandparents with every creature—fish, trees, bacteria.  Life changes gradually over time, accumulating small differences until new forms emerge.

Evolution needs two things: variation (differences between individuals) and selection (some variants survive better than others). Without variation, no change. Without selection, no direction. Both are necessary. Evolution has no goal—it's not 'trying' to create anything.  What fits survives; what doesn't, doesn't.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Change happens whether you guide it or not.  Conscious evolution beats unconscious drift.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Conscious Evolution - Try a Variation.

Here's your activity: Pick a routine or behavior you do automatically. Try a small variation this week—different approach, different timing, different method. Notice what works better. This is conscious evolution: vary, select, repeat. This helps you apply evolutionary thinking personally.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about how life changes over time can be applied to conscious evolution - try a variation. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
